title: Stage 12 — the assistant draws a multi-storey wireframe from a plain request, and the repo skills become harness guardrails
platform: Development browser (Vite dev server 127.0.0.1:8091 with the user-authorized Gemini key) · desktop 1280x800 and tablet 1024x768 · isolated agent-browser profile · no build, installation or native run
summary: The Live assistant can now turn 'draw me a 3-storey 20 m by 12 m wireframe' into real design geometry: draw_architect_elements accepts level, slab, roof, footprint and extrude operations (append-only, validated, stable IDs) and two new read tools explain X-Ray's data model and the source-building reconstruction so the model can reason about the structure before drawing. With the real provider, one message produced three levels, twelve walls, three slabs and a hip roof at 20000 × 12000 mm, saved and restored after reload; a second message added a storey and undid it through the undo tool. Separately, the repository's ledger, X-Ray engine and Fast CDP skills are now enforced by Claude Code hooks that apply to any selected model: whole-tree staging is denied, git history mutations and process kills are gated, the verified-build pointer is guarded, and a completion claim without proof is blocked.

requirements.change: Five new architect operations, two read tools, 56/56 focused tests, typecheck exit 0; real-provider journeys on desktop and tablet with inspected screenshots (proof/growth/2026-09-09-assistant-wireframe/README.md).
